Name: Shane. New Content and Look (Seasonal)
Author: pinzol
Description:
[color=#00ff00][/color][color=#00ff00][/color][color=#e69138][/color][color=#e69138][/color][color=#e69138][/color][color=#e69138][/color][color=#e69138][/color][color=#e69138][/color][color=#e69138][/color][size=5][b][color=#ffff00][b]UPDATED FOR 1.6. NEW LOOK + NEW CONTENT[/b][/color]
[/b][/size]
Shane is my absolute favorite in the game for many personal reasons. So, I decided to go above and beyond for him with this update
and give our Chicken Man tons of new content. Hope you enjoy it! 

[color=#ffff00][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/16968/16968-1734185605-229800730.gif[/img][/color]

[b][size=5]What's New:[/size]
[/b][list]

[*][b][color=#ffff00][size=4]New Portraits and Sprites (Seasonal)[/size][/color][/b]
[/list][list]- [color=#e69138]Seasonal Portraits [/color](and an indoors outfit for fall and winter).
- Completely new character[color=#e69138] Sprites[/color] (versions: with nose, without nose).
- [color=#e69138]Joja Portrait[/color]to go with Shane's Joja sprites.
- New [color=#e69138]Shane's Portrait[/color] that you can buy from the Traveling merchant when you're married to Shane. With nose/without nose option, and also with chicken/without chicken. You can also changes its [color=#e69138]Frame Colour[/color]. It comes in 4 colours: Desert, Birch, Walnut, Stone.
- [color=#e69138]'Cool' Outfit[/color]. An outfit from Emily’s Clothing Therapy event as a possible everyday outfit.[/list][list][list][b][color=#00ffff][size=3]"﻿﻿How to unlock ‘Cool’ Outfit"[/size][/color][/list][/b][list][spoiler][b]
Conditions:[/b]﻿[list]- Have seen Shane’s 8H event.﻿
- Have seen Emily’s 8H event.[color=#e69138][/color][/list][color=#ffff00][b]
When NOT married to Shane: [/b][/color]After seeing both events, talk to Shane to trigger a special conversation topic with him about Emily’s Clothing therapy (That conversation might not come up immediately, sometimes you need to click a few times or on a different day).[b]

[color=#ffff00]When MARRIED to Shane: [/color][/b]This conversation will be available to you on Day 15 (any season). After you’ve picked your answer it won’t come up anymore.

Shane will ask you whether he should embrace wearing that 'Cool' Outfit as he liked it a lot. You will be given 3 options:[list]- [color=#e69138]Of course! You looked so cool in it![/color] (Each day there will be a 10% chance Shane will wear this outfit. There’s a 30% chance Shane will wear it during some of the festivals: Spirit’s Eve, Moonlight Jellies or Flower Dance. You can disable the outfit later through the config file).
- [color=#e69138]Umm, it's a bit too much for an everyday outfit...[/color] (Sets a 50% chance Shane will wear that outfit during some of the festival days: Spirit’s Eve, Moonlight Jellies or Flower Dance. You can disable the outfit later through the config file).
- [color=#e69138]NO! Please don't.[/color] (Shane won’t wear this outfit.)[/list]
[/spoiler][/list]﻿[/list][list][*][b][color=#ffff00][size=4]Two New Events[/size][/color][/b] (Both in 3 parts, so technically 6 events)
[/list][list] - [color=#e69138]Dinner Party Events[/color] (8H event for Shane, Marnie, and Jas).
- [color=#e69138]New 14H Events[/color] (replace the default ones). And an opportunity to learn [color=#e69138]A New Recipe[/color] in the process [/list][list][list][b][color=#00ffff][size=3]"﻿﻿Dinner Party Events Details"[/size][/color][/list][/b][list][spoiler]
I must admit, some of these are a bit lengthy (not too much, but still). I felt like I needed to fit just a bit more content into them than vanilla events have. ﻿[list]
[b][color=#e69138]--- Part 1 -----------------------------------------[/color][/b]

[b]Conditions:[/b]
- Must currently have 8 hearts or more with Shane, Marnie and Jas,
- Have seen Shane’s 8H event,
- It must be year 3 or later,
- 9:00 – 18:00 (9:00AM – 6:00PM),
- Sunny.

[b]What to do:[/b]
Enter the Animal Shop. Farmer and Marnie will watch Shane and Jas play hide-and-seek. Shane will trick Jas in an attempt to win, but that will backfire. Marnie and Farmer will share a warm conversation watching these two from afar. You can have an additional conversation with Shane and Jas after this event.

[b][color=#e69138]--- Part 2 -----------------------------------------[/color][/b]

[b]Conditions:[/b]
- Have seen Part 1,
- At least one day must have passed since Part 1,
- 9:00 – 18:00 (9:00AM – 6:00PM).

[b]What to do:[/b]
Enter Pierre’s Shop. Farmer will find Shane there, looking puzzled. Talk to him to find out what’s on his mind. You can have an additional conversation with Shane and Pierre after this event.

[color=#00ff00][b]Important:[/b][/color]
This event will offer you a choice. Help Shane make a Pink Cake for Jas as an apology for tricking her earlier or refuse to help. If you agree to help, you will be given a Quest to complete in order to see Part 3 event. If you refuse though this live of events will come to an end.

[b][color=#e69138]--- Part 3 -----------------------------------------[/color][/b]

[b]Conditions:[/b]
- Have seen Part 2,
- At least one day must have passed since Part 2,
- Agreed to help Shane in the previous event and thus have the “Family Dinner” Quest active,
- Have Pink Cake in your inventory,
- 17:00 – 19:30 (5:00PM – 7:30PM).

[b]What to do:[/b]
Enter the Animal Shop. Welcome to a family dinner. Have a nice chat with Shane, Marnie and Jas while enjoying the food!

[color=#00ff00][b]Important:[/b][/color]
This event will offer you to choose a toast for the occasion. The first two are sweet, but the last one will lead to losing friendship points with everyone in the room (why would you even say it, really?).

[/list][/list][/spoiler]
[list][b][color=#00ffff][size=3]"14H Events Details"[/size][/color][/list][/b][list][spoiler]
I felt like Shane’s vanilla events weren’t quite… satisfying. And didn’t fit well with the 14H events which supposed to show your spouse’s growth and give you two a meaningful moment to share I kept the premise of Farmer and Marnie catching Shane sneaking into the Saloon but changed the whole purpose behind it. It’s simple but rather sweet. Hope you like it guys![list]
[b][color=#e69138]--- Part 1 -----------------------------------------[/color][/b]

[b]Conditions:[/b]
- Must be married to Shane,
- Must currently have 14 hearts with Shane,
- NOT a Festival day,
- NOT winter,
- 12:00 – 20:00 (12:00PM – 8:00PM),
- Sunny.

[b]What to do:[/b]
Enter Town. Farmer, Marnie and Jas, as in the default event, will notice coming out of the Saloon. Shane looking a bit stressed hurries home. Farmer discusses it with Marnie and Jas. You can have an additional conversation with Shane and Jas after this event.

[color=#e69138][b]--- Part 2 -----------------------------------------[/b]
This event is QUITE lengthy compared to vanilla ones. I apologize for that. But I really wanted to make it that way.[/color]

[b]Conditions:[/b]
- Must be married to Shane,
- Must currently have 14 hearts with Shane,
- Must have seen Part 1,
- At least one day must have passed since Part 1,
- NOT a Festival day,
- 16:00 – 22:00 (4:00PM – 10:00PM).

[b]What to do:[/b]
Enter Town. Farmer secretly watches as Shane enters the Saloon again. After a moment of hesitation, they decide to follow him there. Find out what he’s really been up to. You can have an additional conversation with Shane and Gus (hard to trigger) after this event.

[color=#00ff00][b]Important:[/b][/color]
This event presents you with a choice: React apologetically for being curious and following Shane into the bar. Or lay out your initial suspicions to him, telling him you thought he was drinking there again. The choice is yours, and each option will lead to Part 3 but with a different tone and mood.

[color=#e69138][b]--- Part 3 -----------------------------------------[/b]
Be aware that if you’ve got some mods that change the default layout and appearance of the kitchen, this event might look weird.[/color]

[b]Conditions:[/b]
- Farmhouse must be upgraded to at least level 2,
- Must be married to Shane,
- Must currently have 14 hearts with Shane,
- Must have seen Part 2,
- Only in case if you chose an apologetic (first) answer in Part 2: least 4 days must have passed since Part 2,
- 8:00 – 12:00 (8:00AM – 12:00PM),
- Sunny.

[b]What to do:[/b]
Enter the Farmhouse between 8:00 and 12:00. Shane will be busy in the kitchen. Join him for a sweet conversation and continuation of the Part 2 event. It will be slightly different depending on your choice in the Part 2. You can have an additional conversation with Shane after this event. [b]You will unlock the new recipe at the end of this event[/b].

[color=#00ff00] [b]Important:[/b]
The recipe was added in the last update so if you had this mod installed before and have already seen the last part of the event (in the kitchen), then you can unlock it another way: Gus will be randomly selling this new dish at the Saloon. There's a somewhat 33% chance of it appearing on the list. As soon as you buy it from him for the first time you'll unlock the recipe.[/color]

[/list][/list][/spoiler][/list]

[/list][list][color=#f4f4f4]-[/color][color=#e69138] Friends/Dating/Engaged. [/color]Replaces some of the more negative and alcohol related dialogues AFTER Shane’s 6.8H event.[color=#f4f4f4]

- Flower dance spouse accept invitation to dance line.
[/list]

[*][b][color=#ffff00][size=4]Shane’s Shop, New Items, Clothes and A New Chicken[/size][/color][/b]
[/list][list]- You can help Shane open [color=#e69138]A Little Shop[/color] after his 8H Event. You'll need to talk to him about it twice, encourage this idea and finish [color=#e69138]a Special Order[/color] to build his booth. Be aware that you can pretty much fail it.
- Shane’s Shop comes with lots of new [color=#e69138]Chicken-related Items[/color]. Among them are: Blue and purple eggs, New types of Mayo, Pickled eggs, Chicken Statues, Decorative items from the Egg festival,
- There's also [color=#e69138]New Clothes[/color]: 12 hats and 5 Shirts you can buy from the Shop. 4 boots you can craft using the Mysterious Egg (check images for the mod for more info).
- After opening the shop, you'll be able to make your own [color=#e69138]Golden, Blue, Purple and Brown Mayo[/color] (keep in mind that you'll need to put [color=#e69138]3 eggs[/color] of each kind into the machine to get this new type of mayo. Your mayo will always be silver and provide less bonuses than the ones sold by Shane).
- After opening the shop, you’ll be able to hatch [color=#e69138]Blue and Purple Chickens[/color] from Blue and Purple Eggs, respectively.[/list][list][list][b][color=#00ffff][size=3]"How to open Shane’s Shop"[/size][/color][/b][/list][list][spoiler]
If you succeed, [b]Shane’s Shop[/b] will be open on Mon, Wed and Fri, 10:00-17:00 . It must NOT be Winter and it must NOT be raining.

[b]Shane will be selling different things every season: [/b][list][size=2]- [color=#e69138]Purple and Brown[/color] egg products in Spring,
- [color=#e69138]Blue and Golden[/color] egg products in Summer (he will also very rarely sell golden eggs after you unlock them in the game),
- [color=#e69138]White and Black[/color] egg products in Fall,
- Shane will randomly sell [color=#e69138]Chicken Hats[/color] and [color=#e69138]Chicken Statues[/color],
- [color=#e69138]A Mysterious Egg[/color] will also randomly appear at his shop.[/size][/list]
He will also open his booth during [color=#e69138]the Egg Festival[/color] every even year (2,4,6,8 etc.) and sell some new decor and his rarest goods like Golden Mayo or Mysterious Eggs there.

-------------------------------------------------------------------

[color=#ffff00][b]When NOT married to Shane.[/b][/color]

[b]Conditions:[/b][list]- Have seen Shane’s 8H event,
- Finished Community Center (only for the Second Conversation).[/list]
[color=#e69138][b]First Conversation:[/b][/color] About 4 days after seeing Shane’s 8H event you will trigger a new conversation with him (it might not come up immediately but it will, try to talk to him a few times). Shane will tell you that lately he’s been thinking about opening his own shop. You can either support or doubt him – it won’t really matter at this point.

[color=#e69138][b]Second Conversation:[/b][/color] Next if you’ve finished Community Center AND it’s been at least a week since the first conversation, Shane will have a new one. And this time he’ll inform you that he’s very much ready to open his new shop. All he needs is to build a small booth, and he’ll ask you for help. If you turn him down Shane won’t open his shop. If you agree to help him you’ll start a new special order.

[color=#e69138][b]Special order (for Two Weeks):[/b][/color]You’ll need to collect the following items: 100 pieces of Hardwood, 40 Clay, 15 Iron Bars, and 10 Joja Colas. Place them in the open box with an "S" on it inside his Chicken Barn (new map, unlocked after Shane's 8H event). Be aware that if you don’t finish it in time and fail this order, Shane won’t ever open his Shop.

If you successfully finish this quest Shane will send you a letter next day inviting you to visit his Shop near the Saloon.
[b][color=#00ff00](Don't forget to open this letter as it's an important trigger for this mod and for Shane's Shop to work properly!)[/color][/b]

-------------------------------------------------------------------

[color=#ffff00][b]When MARRIED to Shane.[/b][/color]
If for some reason you missed these conversations before marrying Shane or you just installed the mod while already being married to Shane in your save, you too have a way to open his shop.

[b]Conditions:[/b][list]- Have Shane as your spouse,
- Finished Community Center (only for the Second Conversation).[/list]
[color=#e69138][b]First Conversation:[/b][/color] It will be available to you on Day 9 or 22 (any season). Talk to Shane on that day. Sometimes another dialogue rewrites this conversation. Try clicking on Shane again after his daily dialogue or wait till another [b]Day 9[/b] or [b]22[/b].

[color=#e69138][b]Second Conversation:[/b][/color] It will be available to you on [b]Day 9 [/b]or[b] 22[/b] (any season) after you've finished the first conversation. It will go the same as in an unmarried version above and you will too have to finish a Special Order if you agree to help Shane.

[color=#e69138][b]Special order (for Two Weeks):[/b][/color] Goes the same as in an unmarried version of it.

[/spoiler]

I made a few changes to the map, added a new sign and new chickens inside.

- A variety of [color=#e69138]Sectional Shelves[/color].
- Small [color=#e69138]Chicken Paintings[/color] (6 in 1) and (3 in 1). [color=#00ff00](Check mod's [b]Images Tab[/b] for pictures).[/color]

[list][b][color=#00ffff][size=3]"How to Unlock the Furniture"[/size][/color][/b][/list][list][spoiler][b]Conditions:[/b][list]- Unlock [color=#e69138]Shane’s Shop[/color],
- Buy at least one [color=#e69138]New Chicken Statue[/color] of every color from Shane’s Shop.[/list]
There are 5 new Chicken Statues at Shane’s shop: [color=#e69138]Blue, Brown, Golden, Black, and Purple.[/color] (I made them to complement the vanilla White Chicken artifact, so that together they can make a cute looking collection.) These statues are sold randomly across different seasons. After you’ve purchased one of each, you’ll receive [color=#e69138]A Letter from Shane[/color] thanking you for supporting his shop. Along with the letter, he’ll send you a nice wooden cabinet to display your statues. He’ll also mention that Robin has created a whole [color=#e69138]New Furniture Catalogue[/color], which you can occasionally find at her shop for [color=#e69138]30,000 G[/color].
[/list][/spoiler][/list]

[size=3][b]Configuration options[/b][/size]

[list][b][color=#00ffff][size=2]"For Shane 1.6 [FULL] version"[/size][/color][/b][/list][list][spoiler]
[color=#e69138][b][Use New Portraits/Sprites or Not][/b][/color]
[color=#00ff00]SMAPI will show you a yellow warning when you disable either of the options in this section. It's alright, it's just because of the way it's coded to load in the game, so pay no attention to it. You'll also need to reload the save when you enable/disable any of them.[/color]

[b]Seasonal Outfits [True/False][/b][list]– Whether to use my new Portraits and Sprites for Shane or not. Turn them off in case you're already using another mod for Shane.[/list]
[b]Cool Outfit (additional) [True/False][/b][list]– My mod introduces an additional outfit from Emily's Clothing therapy and it's tied to the new content. You can turn it off if you're using some other portrait mod. It won't matter too much.[/list]
[color=#e69138][b][Appearance Settings][/b][/color]
[b]Shane's Sprite Face [/b][list]- Edited (No Nose) – Shane’s sprites will resemble other character’s sprites more, no nose and bigger eyes.
- Default (With Nose) – Shane’s face on sprites will be with nose and smaller eyes, as in vanilla version.[/list]
[b]Shane's Painting (the one you can get from the Traveling Merchant when married to someone)[/b]
[list]- With Chicken – Shane will appear holding a chicken on the painting,
- Without Chicken – The default like painting with just Shane on it.[/list]
[b]Painting Frame (change the frame of the Shane's Painting)[/b]
[list]- Desert, Walnut, Birch, Stone, Vanilla[/list]
